normalization: Binary paths, synthetic HOME/HERMES_HOME paths, PTY paths, timestamps, process identifiers, raw redraw bytes, and ephemeral server ports are omitted or represented by stable markers.

The loopback server accepts only local OpenAI-compatible requests and records normalized message roles/content markers, model, stream flag, request count, and authorization presence; no credentials or external network are used.
The display transcript may retain bootstrap and failed diagnostic messages, but provider payloads are evaluated against the typed completed-turn lifecycle rather than rendered text.

The failed-turn follow-up intentionally excludes the failed user prompt and partial assistant diagnostic text while preserving prior successful turns; automatic retries remain outside the user submission boundary.
